name: ElasticLetters
description: Headline whose letters bounce in on mount and then react to the pointer: letters near the cursor lift, stretch, thicken, and tint toward an accent color, driven by per-letter spring physics that settle with an elastic wobble.
a11yNotes: The text is read once from a visually hidden span; the per-letter spans are aria-hidden. The pointer effect is purely decorative and needs no keyboard equivalent. Under prefers-reduced-motion there is no intro and no pointer reaction. The spring loop sleeps when settled, pauses off-screen via IntersectionObserver, and is cancelled on unmount.

propsApi.name: text
propsApi.description: Text whose letters react to the pointer.

propsApi.name: radius
propsApi.description: Radius of pointer influence in pixels.

propsApi.name: stiffness
propsApi.description: Spring stiffness; higher snaps back faster.

propsApi.name: damping
propsApi.description: Spring damping; lower values wobble longer.

propsApi.name: intro
propsApi.description: Play a staggered elastic drop-in when mounted.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Tint that excited letters blend toward.

propsApi.name: color
propsApi.description: Resting text color (defaults to the theme foreground).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element (CSS variables included).
